messages.author: eb9a4188a4906706
messages.subject: path.expand error
parts:
Hi there

I am comming back to Biogeobears, I noticed there are some changes and source codes that need to be uploaded. Well, I came with an issue that seems pretty simple but I am not sure how to solve it.
I am just having trouble when executing Biogeobears, the problem seems to be when reading the following line in the internal Biogeobears commands:

np(BioGeoBEARS_run_object$trfn) at BioGeoBEARS_univ_model_v1.R

The error is the following: Error in path.expand(path) : invalid 'path' argument 

I set my working directory to a folder where the tree files and dispersal matrices are stored, but I am not pretty sure why it is not working. So any advice will be appreciated.


Best!

messages.author: eb9a4188a4906706
messages.subject: Re: path.expand error
parts:
I already solved the problem thanks! It was not working because I was storing my tree as trfn=read.tree(tree_file) instead of trfn="tree_file, using the last option worked fine.

Cheers!

messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] path.expand error
parts:
On 3/25/14 8:59 PM, Francisco wrote:
> Hi there
>
> I am comming back to Biogeobears, I noticed there are some
> changes and source codes that need to be uploaded. Well, I
> came with an issue that seems pretty simple but I am not
> sure how to solve it.
> I am just having trouble when executing Biogeobears, the
> problem seems to be when reading the following line in the
> internal Biogeobears commands:
>
> np(BioGeoBEARS_run_object$trfn) at BioGeoBEARS_univ_model_v1.R
>
> The error is the following: Error in path.expand(path) :
> invalid 'path' argument

Hi,

This means that whatever you have stored in:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object$trfn

...is non-existent. Probably you moved a file or directory.
To fix, just set:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object$trfn =
"correct_path/correct_tree_filename"

Note: trfn just means tree file name

Cheers,
Nick

> I set my working directory to a folder where the tree files
> and dispersal matrices are stored, but I am not pretty sure
> why it is not working. So any advice will be appreciated.
>
>
> Best!
